sectors.trend: Oil at $97, diesel at all-time high; Strait of Hormuz crisis and Iran-Ukraine wars constricting supply. Bessent's $40 post-war target creates massive two-sided volatility.
sectors.implications: Energy E&Ps (EOG, KNOT) benefit near-term from $97 oil; midstream and downstream face margin compression. Diesel spike hits transportation and consumer costs. Post-war $40 scenario is a long-term bear case for energy equities.

sectors.trend: Micron above $1,000; Broadcom earnings beat but stock fell; Palantir wins Army contract but loses Burry; Bloom Energy added to S&P 500; FICO plunges on regulatory threat.
sectors.implications: Semiconductor strength (Micron, NXP) reflects AI capex cycle. Broadcom's $230B signal suggests massive forward revenue visibility. FICO's regulatory risk is a structural threat to credit-scoring duopoly. Palantir's defense wins validate govtech thesis.

sectors.trend: Fed hike odds rising; 10Y yield >5%; mortgage rates highest in a year; FHFA threatens FICO model; Lloyds Bank reverses customer rule; Robinhood vs AMC token dispute.

sectors.trend: Stryker acquires ZuriMED; Amneal bets on biosimilars; BeOne secures pharma tariff exemption; Erasca gets FDA fast track; BioAge CV risk data pending; Campbell's workforce cuts.

sectors.trend: Campbell's 13% workforce cut; E. coli blueberry recall at Walmarts; Labor Day sales; GameStop $358M note exchange; women in drag racing.
sectors.implications: CPG sector under margin pressure driving structural cost cuts. Food safety recalls create short-term brand risk. Labor Day sales test consumer spending resilience amid high rates. GameStop's capital allocation shift signals maturity.

sectors.trend: US strikes Iranian tankers; EU urges max pressure on Russia; Pentagon leadership concerns; Leonardo sees Ukraine as acquisition outpost; Palantir wins Army contract; Cerberus Pentagon deals under review.
sectors.implications: Defense spending remains structurally elevated. Ukraine as M&A platform for European defense (Leonardo). Pentagon leadership instability creates procurement uncertainty. Cerberus review signals political risk in defense contracting.

market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from Fed hike probability, 10Y >5%, and energy inflation. Expect continued equity volatility with sector rotation toward energy, defense, and short-duration bonds. Oil likely stays $90-100 range. Mortgage rates may test 7%. Bitcoin volatile around $81K. European de-risking may accelerate. 2-3 week window of elevated VIX.
market_outlook.long_term: Bessent's $40 oil post-Iran war target implies eventual energy disinflation, supporting equities in 6-12 month view. AI capex cycle (Broadcom $230B, Micron $1,000) sustains tech leadership. Fed hiking cycle likely peaks by Q1 2027, enabling rate cuts. Defense spending structurally elevated. Pharma onshoring and biosimilars create multi-year themes. Geopolitical fragmentation persists but doesn't derail growth.
